sourceNotes.rawContent: Celebrate eternal love with this chic gold-toned bracelet featuring an interlocking crystal heart and infinity symbol. This high-fashion statement piece adds a sentimental glow to any look. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after use.
